description: Fetch one specific Business Wire release by its URL or release id (source: businesswire.com), as returned by businesswire_latest_releases or businesswire_search_releases. Re-fetches the live channel each call — a release older than the ~7-day window will not be found.

url.description: The release URL or release_id (e.g. 20260921847964en) from a prior businesswire tool call.

name: businesswire_get_release
